title: add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples; docs site updates
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Add RAG agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples. Docs site sidebar updated to include new quickstarts. No runtime changes.
description: Motivation: Provide opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling and multi-step agents for common developer workflows (customer support triage, internal knowledge search, and codebase Q&A). This PR adds curated quickstart examples, templates for agent composition, and updates the docs site navigation so the new content is discoverable. Related Linear: ENG-1245, PM-78. What changed: added three quickstart folders under redwood-examples/rag-quickstarts (support-agent, code-search-agent, onboarding-agent); added docs guides explaining agent architecture, tool-calling contract, and security considerations; updated docs site sidebar and search index. Checklist: - [x] Add example code and README for each quickstart - [x] Add agent template YAMLs and example tool plugins - [x] Update docs guide with architecture diagrams and example traces - [x] Add unit tests for example scaffolding and example CI job to validate docs build - [x] Manual QA: run quickstarts locally + verify docs render in preview deployment Testing and CI: unit-tests and lint passed; integration-tests initially flaked on the new docs-build job in CI (timing issue with search index) but were re-run and passed. No production runtime changes. Migration notes: none. How to review: run the quickstart scripts in redwood-examples/rag-quickstarts and follow the step-by-step READMEs; validate docs at /docs/guides/rag-agent and confirm sidebar entries under "Guides > Agents & RAG". Implementation details: - Examples use the Redwood Python SDK quickstart harness and include prebuilt prompt templates and evaluation harness stubs - Tool-calling examples demonstrate safe tool schemas and sanitization hooks; example tools include an HTTP search adapter and a local code-indexer plugin - Docs include a short section on performance considerations (batching KV cache reuse) and recommended model/quantization profiles for low-latency customer-facing agents Notes: kept examples intentionally small to avoid large diffs; follow-on work will add CI-driven evals and additional templates for vector DB connectors.
